```{r}

library(dplyr)

Total <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data,"derived/Total.shp"))
Observateurs <- utils::read.csv(paste0(wd$data,"derived/Observateurs.csv"), sep=";")

Total <- Total %>%
  transform_Total() %>%
  ajoute_clust_a_Total() %>%
  ajout_famille_paysage() %>%
  ajout_10x10_predetermine() %>%
  creer_maille(taille_en_km = 2) %>%
  creer_maille(taille_en_km = 5) %>%
  creer_maille(taille_en_km = 10) %>%
  creer_maille(taille_en_km = 20)

sf::st_write(Total, paste0(wd$data, "derived/TotalComplet.shp"))
```
